title: One hour of rain, hours of congestion: Gurugram's waterlogging woes persist
description: Heavy rain brought Gurugram traffic to a crawl on Saturday, with 36 mm of rainfall recorded in an hour, causing waterlogging across several key roads and junctions. The downpour disrupted traffic from Sarhaul Border to Rajiv Chowk and affected areas including Sohna Road, Golf Course Extension Road and Udyog Vihar
